sources.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds Year Two updates and DLC announced
sources.text: SEGA has announced new updates and downloadable content coming to crossover racing game Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds in Year Two, which officially starts on November 3. New updates coming to Sonic Racing: Crossworlds include: Season Pass Two brings an all-new roadmap of six premium downloadable content Packs, all based on exciting collaborations with iconic entertainment franchises and each offering a uniquely themed package of CrossWorlds game content. The purchasable downloadable contents include: In addition to all of the above updates, the suite of Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds game products will be undergoing a number of changes to appeal to both the dedicated players looking to expand their CrossWorlds experience and the brand-new players looking to enter the race for the very first time: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds is available now for PlayStation 5 , Xbox Series , Switch 2 , PlayStation 4 , Xbox One , Switch , and PC via Steam and Epic Games Store . sources.name: Video Games Chronicle
sources.title: Sonic Racing Crossworlds Year 2 crossovers revealed, including Final Fantasy 7, Hello Kitty and retro Sega
sources.text: The game has also received a permanent price drop Sega has announced the details for Year 2 of Sonic Racing Crossworld’s DLC content, as well as a permanent price drop for the base game. As with the Year 1 content, Year 2 will consist of six paid crossover packs, as well as regular monthly free content. The game’s Year 2 season officially starts on November 3, with the first paid crossover pack based on Godzilla . This will include a new track in which Godzilla attacks the City Escape level from Sonic Adventure 2, as well as three new vehicles based on Godzilla, Mothra and King Ghidorah. Sega had already previously confirmed that Year 2 would also include a paid DLC pack based on Evangelion , but it’s now confirmed what the other four packs will be. Pack 3 will called Virtual Sanrio Puroland Pack , and will include a track based on the Sanrio Puroland theme park in Japan, as well as Hello Kitty and Kuromi as playable racers. Pack 4 is the Segaland Pack , and includes a new track based on classic Sega games, as well as three new vehicles based on Sega’s Out Run, After Butner and Super Megalo arcade cabinets. DLC Pack 5 has a working title of Midgar Pack , and will include crossover content from the Final Fantasy 7 Remake series. The details of this pack have still to be confirmed. Similarly, DLC Pack 6 is titled the Reload Revival Royal Pack and will include content from the Persona games, which has also still to be confirmed. In terms of free content, the first free DLC character for Year 2 will be added when the season starts on November 3, as Bayonetta arrives. She will be unlockable in a new Rival Duel mode. She’ll be followed later in November by the McLaren Racing DLC, which adds a McLaren F1 car to the game as well as a new Sonic wearing a McLaren suit. Then, in early 2027, Aigis from Persona 3 Reload will be added to the game, along with a car called the Palladion Dressy. Year 2’s paid DLC will be available individually, or available in a Season Pass for $29.99. Players who buy the Season Pass will get access to Genesis, Saturn and Dreamcast controller decal packs now, as well as vehicles based on each console when Year 2 launches on November 3. Players who own both Season Pass 1 and Season Pass 2 will also get Super Shadow and his Super Dark Flare vehicle as an extra bonus. For players new to the game, Sega has also announced a permanent price drop. Effective immediately, the Standard Edition has dropped from $70 to $40, and the Digital Deluxe Edition (which includes all the Year 1 content) has dropped from $90 to $60.

sources.name: GamesRadar
sources.title: Final Fantasy 7 Remake, Persona join the increasingly bonkers roadmap for Sonic Racing Crossworlds
sources.text: Sonic Racing: Crossworlds already has a pretty hectic lineup of characters, but Sega 's Year Two DLC roadmap takes things one step further. The Final Fantasy 7 Remake series, Persona, Godzilla, Hello Kitty, Bayonetta, Evangelion, the Dreamcast itself, and much more are all coming to the well-liked kart racer before the end of 2027. Sonic's most recent and surprisingly great take on kart racing is no stranger to bonkers crossovers. The game's first year of post-launch content welcomed everybody from Spongebob Squarepants and Minecraft Steve to Yakuza's Ichiban Kasuga, but Sega's one-upped itself with Year Two. Year Two includes free content drops throughout 2027, alongside a paid Season Two Pass with exclusive goodies. The free content starts with monster-spanking icon Bayonetta joining the roster, alongside a kart inspired by McLaren and Persona 3's Aigis coming between November and March of next year. The paid Season Two kicks off with a Godzilla collaboration on day one (November 3), bringing karts based on popular kaiju and a track that features our beloved, radioactive 'zilla causing chaos throughout a city. Evangelion is up next with playable characters Asuka Shikinami Langley and Rei Ayanami, plus new karts and a track. Sometime after, we can look forward to playing as Hello Kitty and Kuromi in a course that's inspired by the wider Sanrio universe (if you have a favorite friend, there's a good chance they've been hidden somewhere in the background of the track.) Taking a break from crossovers, the Segaland pack goes back in time with a course that pays tribute to Sega's entire history, arcade classics and home consoles included. Sega's also introducing three karts based on classic arcade cabinets (Outrun, After Burner, and Super Megalo) and three karts based on its consoles (Genesis, Saturn, and Dreamcast), alongside a bonus Super Shadow racer for owners of both Season Passes. And, finally, the Year Two Season Pass ends with two big hitters. A Final Fantasy 7 Remake collaboration is on the way, but all Sega had to show was Cloud's Buster Sword sitting alongside a generic ring from the Sonic series. No word on what this collab includes, exactly. The other pack comes from the Reload Revival Royal pack, which presumably features characters and/or stages from all three modern Persona games. Sign up to our Switch 2 Spotlight newsletter to make sure you get the very latest news on Nintendo's new console and its games every week Despite Sega's Mario Kart World shade, rival racer Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds has "fallen short" of expectations, and compared to Nintendo's sales I can see why Kaan freelances for various websites including Rock Paper Shotgun, Eurogamer, and this one, Gamesradar. He particularly enjoys writing about spooky indies, throwback RPGs, and anything that's vaguely silly. Also has an English Literature and Film Studies degree that he'll soon forget. sources.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds Year Two DLC Roadmap Revealed
sources.text: As the second year of Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds approaches, Sega has revealed extensive plans for the next season of its successful kart racer. This year’s content includes drops from Godzilla and Persona 3, kicking off with a free Bayonetta drop. This season also introduces a major new game mode: a 1v1 Duel Mode that can be played in various ways: With the ability to see your opponents’ items, gadgets, and race position, playing offense and defense with your own items is key to gaining – and keeping – the advantage. Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds brings Godzilla DLC on November 3, 2026, followed by Evangelion in January 2027 as part of its second season pass. Other DLC coming to the game includes a Sanrio pack featuring the playable characters Hello Kitty and Kuromi. The Segaland pack also lets players race through Sega’s history, filled with arcade and home-console homages. The trailer says you can race in vehicle versions of arcade machines, including OutRun and the original Virtua Fighter. Additionally, Sega made good on an April Fools tease by revealing that vehicles based on the Sega Genesis, Sega Saturn, and Sega Dreamcast consoles are coming to the game as well. Season Pass Two brings an all-new roadmap of six premium DLC Packs, featuring even more exciting collaborations with iconic entertainment franchises. DLCs include: Sega also revealed that Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds is getting a price cut, with the base game dropping from $70 to $40 and the digital deluxe edition dropping from $90 to $60. These price cuts are permanent. You can purchase the Season 2 Season Pass for $29.99. How do you feel about all these additions to Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds? If you haven’t played the game yet, does the permanent price cut entice you to pick it up now? Sound off about this story and all others in our official Discord server. sources.title: GTA 6 Fan Says Rockstar Sent Them a Poster Just Because They Asked Nicely
sources.text: A Grand Theft Auto 6 fan in Brazil said they politely asked the Rockstar Games team to send them a poster – and it looks like they actually followed through. Reddit user aogustoo shared their story in a post late last month. What began as a "shot-in-the-dark email" they sent to Rockstar asking for a signed GTA 6 poster has turned into what seems to be a heartwarming moment for them and the community. "A while ago I took a complete shot in the dark and emailed Rockstar," they said. "I shared how hyped I was for GTA VI and asked if there was any chance I could get a poster for my room. "Honestly, I expected an automated reply or nothing at all. To my absolute surprise, an executive actually answered and shipped an official GTA VI poster straight from their New York office to my home in Brazil." You can see images, which show not only the poster but the emails they supposedly sent to receive it, above. As Rockstar (and the rest of the world) count down the days to GTA 6's November 19 launch, fans will no doubt be on the lookout for official merchandise like this. As many have pointed out, it's unclear if Rockstar truly took the time to send the poster, but the community is still looking to the moment as something worth celebrating as the countdown continues. "This is a massive W tho," Rockstar content creator @videotech said on X/Twitter . "This guy isn’t an influencer or someone famous, literally just a random Rockstar fan. Very kind of Rockstar and Take-Two to take the time and effort to do this." "​I blurred out all personal addresses, names, and contact emails to respect their privacy," aogustoo added. "Please don't flood their inbox with requests, as I'm pretty sure this was just a rare act of kindness from someone on their team." There's still so much about GTA 6 that we don’t know, but one thing is for sure: Rockstar will probably get even more emails after this. While we wait to learn more about the next Grand Theft Auto game ahead of its November 19 launch for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, you can check out IGN's recent interview with Rockstar North's Rob Nelson . You can also read about what Nintendo had to say about the chances of seeing GTA 6 on Switch 2 , some recently revealed radio stations , and even a batch of new screenshots . sources.name: Xbox Wire
sources.title: DMZ — 5 Features to Get Excited for in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4’s New Mode
sources.text: Call of Duty’s upcoming DMZ mode sounds like it’s shaping up to be something special. Set on the new Hajin map and inspired by the events and locations from Modern Warfare 4 ’s Campaign, this open-world combat environment will challenge you to loot, complete objectives, fight both enemies and rival Operators, and extract before everything you’ve earned is lost. Recent intel drops on the official Call of Duty Blog have given us a much clearer picture of what awaits in Hajin when DMZ launches as part of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 . Players who have digitally pre-ordered or pre-purchased Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 can gain Early Access to the game’s Campaign starting Friday, October 16 and all of DMZ starting Tuesday, October 20. The events within DMZ are set after the main MW4 Campaign, leaving a power vacuum in its wake. Now it’s up to you to identify a new, mysterious threat and dismantle its operations across the DMZ through various deployments. From scavenging for crafting materials and experimenting with new technology, to leveling up an Operator, the mode sounds like it offers plenty to look forward to. Here are five features to get excited for when you begin your deployment. The 3D Printer will be available back at the Forward Operating Base (FOB) between deployments and will serve as your primary crafting station to build equipment and upgrades for your loadout before you drop into Hajin. The Call of Duty Blog shares that , as you progress through the DMZ, you’ll unlock new crafting recipes to create more powerful equipment – as well as upgrades to the 3D Printer and even the Forward Operating Base itself. Recipes can also be found on deployments and, presuming you extract in one piece, you can then craft those items for your Operator back at the FOB. When focused on crafting new equipment, the two key things you’ll be looking for when looting on deployments will be Resources and 3D Printer Ingredients – these are the two types of main elements to craft all items. There are four basic Resources to find during a deployment: Synthetics, Electronics, Chemicals, and Metals, automatically broken down from looted items, into your Backpack and Stash. 3D Printer Ingredients are rarer materials found in specific areas of Hajin and are valuable as an ingredient to make a new Item. Examples include Binding Catalyst, Biomaterials, Detonators, and Control Units, to name a few. Once you have enough of these two types of materials, you can select how many copies of an item you want to craft at once, then choose where crafted items go: send completed items directly to your Stash for later or equip them directly to your Operator to quickly prepare for the next deployment. Having this flexibility in how you want to engage the enemy during your deployment can open a variety of experiences in DMZ and can make each deployment feel like it matters, even if you come back to the FOB with zero kills to your name – at least you’ve got handful of electronics or a comms module to make it worth your time. Extraction shooters are always more engaging when every deployment has a clear purpose. That’s not going to be problem with DMZ as it will offer three ways to deploy: Story Missions, Dynamic Operations, and Free Roam. Of those, Story Missions and Dynamic Operations are two that really stand out with their defined objectives and high-tier rewards. According to the Call of Duty Blog , Story Missions will feature narrative-led deployments that you can complete and replay, though some remain locked until prerequisites are met. Each entry provides briefing intel, required objectives, and rewards – usually high-value gear and DMZ Cash – along with options for a random mission and additional milestone rewards. Dynamic Operations, meanwhile, give squads multiple goals to pursue within the DMZ. After deploying, you choose an operation and complete its objectives to earn DMZ XP, Cash, and the ability to call in a Supply Drop filled with unpredictable loot. That extra payoff adds anticipation to every successful Op while making Dynamic Operations a promising source of both Cash and XP. Persistent Operators may be DMZ’s most exciting feature because they allow Hajin to leave a lasting mark on you. You’ll begin with two Operator slots, and unlock a third as you progress through DMZ levels. Each Operator then grows stronger by surviving deployments and earning DMZ XP. Each successful exfil levels up your Operator’s Dog Tags, and this is the key to gaining Trait Points for your Operator. You can invest those points across the Warfighter, Scout, and Survivalist Trait Trees, creating a meaningful choice between specialization and flexibility: with a maximum of 18 points to earn, and a choice of over 60 Trait Points to augment your Operator, you can tailor each Operator to your skills and preferred role. For example, Warfighter Traits include Combat Resistance, Quick Fix, and Viper Sense; Scout Traits include improved Thermal Padding, UAV Upgrade, and Field Crafting; while Survivalist Traits include Faster and Free Revives, increased Consumable Duration, and many more. But here’s where it gets dicey: if an Operator fails to extract and becomes MIA, you must either recover them with DMZ Cash or dismiss them. Because recovery costs rise with Trait investment, bringing back a high-level Operator becomes increasingly expensive. Recovered Operators keep their Traits but lose their gear, putting real weight behind every deployment. The chase for loot is at the heart of every extraction shooter, and DMZ makes each haul matter beyond the current deployment. Returning to base with a pack full of supplies doesn’t just feel rewarding – it improves your chances of success the next time you enter Hajin. Once you drop into a deployment, looting should be a top priority. Searching containers provides resources for combat, supports marked Operations, strengthens your position in Hajin, and offers a reliable way to earn DMZ XP and adva

sources.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Launch Rollout Adds DMZ Early Access
sources.text: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has added DMZ to its list of early access experiences available for pre-order players ahead of its launch later this month. Activision and Infinity Ward revealed a host of new details for its DMZ revamp in a blog post shared today. Early access for the mode joins campaign early access , with both available to those who pre-ordered either the standard or Vault Edition versions of the game across PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and/or Xbox Series X/S. Here's the full breakdown: Eligible players will gain early access to the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 campaign starting Friday, October 16. DMZ early access will then follow Tuesday, October 20, with the full launch unleashing the rest of the experience come Friday, October 23. All of the new details arrived with a new gameplay trailer for DMZ, which you can see below. DMZ was first introduced as Call of Duty's take on the extraction shooter experience with 2022's Modern Warfare 2 . It was expanded upon in the months that followed but was ultimately deemed to be an underwhelming prototype by many. Support ended in late 2023, and now, Activision is taking another swing at it. The DMZ in Modern Warfare 4 has been propped up as a fully fleshed-out evolution for the game mode. In today's post, Infinity Ward described the new take on the mode as the series' "definitive extraction shooter experience," promising persistent progression in the open-world combat environment known as the Hajin Exclusion Zone. "There's an interesting story with the DMZ beta, where we had to make some decisions," studio multiplayer creative director Joe Cecot said in a recent behind-the-scenes video (below). "Certain things we wanted to do, we couldn't do. At the end of the day, we learned a lot: That we made a very approachable, fun sandbox that was fun to fight in, to explore, to make friends in, to get into fights in. There's a bunch of stuff we left on the table, so as soon as we finished with the last game, we were just gung-ho on, 'OK, we know what we want to do.'" Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches October 23 for PC and consoles. Our first proper look at DMZ gameplay arrived in June, with even more details shared earlier this week. While early access players will get to dive into DMZ and the story mode a few days earlier than others, core multiplayer offerings won't officially launch until that firm release date hits. You can see how the team at Infinity Ward is working to deal with wall-hack cheaters here . Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. sources.title: Phantom Blade Zero’s Fast-Paced Action Took 15 Years, Two RPG-Maker Games, And A Whole Lot Of Money To Bring To Life
sources.text: Action-RPG Phantom Blade Zero S-GAME Studio I’ve been tracking the release of Phantom Blade Zero for several years now, playing the game multiple times over the course of three years, from demos that felt like little more than vertical slices all the way to a multi-hour hands-on at Gamescom this year. For a time, it felt like the game had come out of nowhere; I’d never encountered Chinese developer S-Game’s previous titles, and assumed they were never released outside of the country. However, it turns out I simply wasn’t paying attention, and Phantom Blade Zero is part of a franchise known as Rainblood that’s over 15 years old and features a longtime series protagonist who has only so many days to live, while the games themselves have sought to create their own new genre and style. Across 2010 and 2011, two Rainblood games were released, with only the first making it to the West via a fan translation apparently approved by the developer, S-Game CEO Qiwei “Soulframe” Liang, and being sold on fan sites. These titles are turn-based RPGs set in the same world as Phantom Blade , and seem to share almost no gameplay DNA with the upcoming triple-A game. In 2013, they were followed up by Rain Blood Chronicles: Mirage (yes, Rain Blood is two words now), a Unity-powered hack-and-slash 2D brawler which did actually make its way to Steam and consoles—though the Xbox and PlayStation versions now seem to be delisted. All three of these games are noticeably unpolished, but make up for it with their striking, dark and twisted interpretation of the Ming Dynasty. Following Mirage , S-game published three China-exclusive mobile games. Then in May 2023, Phantom Blade Zero , a big-budget 3D action game, was announced, followed by the release of Phantom Blade: Executioners in November, a 2D beat ’em up which came out on PS4, PS5, and mobile, though again the console ports seem to have been pulled. Both of these games share commonalities with Soulframe’s earlier releases, most notably a recurring motif of crimson blades wielded by the protagonist that stand out in the often grim and grey world; however, these games feel noticeably small compared to a triple-A game featuring Donnie Yen. All this leads to the question: Where did the exponential increase in fidelity and scope come from? The short answer, via a machine-translated article in Chinese publication ChuApp , seems to be “Tencent.” Following the completion of rounds of funding from NetEase and the Chinese venture capital firm ZhenFund, Soulframe disclosed in an open letter in 2021 that Lingyou Fang—or, as it’s called in the West, S-Game—“recently completed a round of financing on the scale of hundreds of millions of dollars” from the Chinese mega-corp for two large-scale action RPGs over the next five years. While the second of these projects, “Stellar Saga,” is still MIA, the other is the continuation of Soulframe’s long-running series. Which all brings us to now, and my four-ish hours with Phantom Blade Zero . Something that I have noted in my previous time with this game is that while it bears some surface-level similarities to the assortment of Chinese-developed Souls -inspired games like Black Myth: Wukong and Wuchang: Fallen Feathers , in practice it plays closer to a hybrid of Sekiro and Devil May Cry, fusing elements of the former’s fast, stagger-focused combat with the latter’s stylish action-game sensibilities. This design ethos is best showcased in how the stamina bar functions. Oftentimes in games that seek to offer a faster version of a typical Souls -like combat system, I find myself frustrated by the fact that I can combo chains of attacks with flashy animations, but because each swing of the sword eats away at my stamina bar, I often find myself incapable of extricating myself from enemies’ ripostes. Phantom Blade addresses this, as your stamina doesn’t go down when attacking or successfully blocking, only when dodging or attempting to block certain color-coded attacks. Moreover, your light attacks do not take animation priority over all other inputs, meaning that if you start a swing only to realize a boss will strike you first, you can quickly hit block mid-attack to protect yourself. This focus on offensive combat over a muddled mix of Souls -ish turtling, stamina regen, and protracted combos instantly makes Phantom Blade both more intuitive than some of its closest contemporaries and more compelling and cohesive. The design seems to be less focused on finding ways to force wuxia into a Souls game and more focused on creating a combat system purpose-built to highlight both the flow and speed of wuxia media, resulting in something I find infinitely more interesting and rewarding. Phantom Blade ’s free-flowing combat focuses on 30 primary weapons, each with its own unique moveset and properties, and 25 secondary weapons, some of which, like axes, grant you heavy charge attacks while others, like mini-cannons, are slow-firing ranged weapons. You can equip two primary weapons at a time, keeping one off-hand and ready to go; however, while you can simply swap to your other primary by hitting the D-pad, you can also work it into a combo with the left trigger. This system is interesting because the combo-weapon-change both deal a lot of damage and stagger to enemies but is also on a cooldown, meaning that if you get into a good flow dealing with a boss with a longsword, comboing away from it to your dual-blades might not actually be the best move. While the combat of Phantom Blade Zero feels distinctly un-Soulslike, the same cannot be said for the world. The press release for the game highlights that Phantom Blade ’s interconnected world is “inspired by Soulslike map design.” In lieu of a traditional, highly detailed video game map, you’re instead provided with hand-painted, ink wash–style charts of the area painted on Xuan paper and scanned into the game. sources.title: Shadow of the Road delayed to March 10, 2027
sources.text: Publisher Owlcat Games and developer Another Angle Games have delayed story-driven turn-based RPG Shadow of the Road from its previously planned November 12, 2026 release date to March 10, 2027. It will be available for PC via Steam , Epic Games Store , and GOG . Here is the full explanation from Owlcat Games: This extra time will let the developers address remaining issues and give the whole experience the polish it deserves. The team will refine the tactical aspect of the encounters and fine-tune combat balance. It is of great importance that the positioning, initiative and ability choices all play their part in every battle and that every encounter rewards thoughtful planning and provides players with meaningful decisions to make. The developers are also hard at work on the progression systems in order to make developing the party more engaging: The goal is to give players more reasons to experiment with different skills and adapt their tactics to the challenges. During this longer period of waiting, fans of Shadow of the Road can look forward to more trailers and insights into the game world soon.

stories.title: Wardogs' New Rain System Will Have a Major Effect on Gameplay in Season 2
stories.summary: Wardogs developer Bulkhead has revealed how rain will change the gameplay in Season 2.

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: Wardogs' New Rain System Will Have a Major Effect on Gameplay in Season 2
sources.text: Wardogs developer Bulkhead has revealed how rain will change the gameplay in Season 2. Next week, Wardogs will release its second season of content, which will also add rain to the game. This will not be dynamic weather, so don't expect it to be sunshine one minute and storming the next; matches that include rain will experience rainfall the entire time, from start to finish. However, this will result in some major changes to the game, with senior producer Kane Allard confirming to IGN that it "completely changes the game," and as a result, some players may not actually like this addition. "It completely changes the game, and it's going to be positive for some players," said Allard. "It's going to be negative for others. Your play styles might be affected. That's okay. It's not like every map's going to be permanently rain. It's just going to be almost like a different game mode, so to speak. [It] could be that some people really love rain, some people really hate rain based on how you want to play. But it does bring a lot." As for how things change, it's pretty drastic. The map is obviously darker, and your visibility is worsened. One developer even stated that he lost his sense of direction on the map because he wasn't used to the way it looked now. The storms will cause thunder, which can be strategically used to mask gunfire or other loud noises. Raindrops will make different sounds based on the surfaces they're hitting, including rooftops and helmets. Windows will also fog up, though it's unclear if that allows players to be less visible when hiding in buildings. The team has also accounted for destruction, meaning if a roof is destroyed, players inside will be exposed to the rain. As for other weather effects, Bulkhead isn't ruling anything out, but it has to consider how something like snow would change the game both in terms of gameplay and how the game performs. Bulkhead CEO Joe Brammer stated that there are obvious changes to something like nighttime, which would add flashlights, NVGs, and lasers. Maybe one day we'll get more, but it sounds like it may take some time to get added. We've got plenty more on Wardogs, including Bulkhead on why blue team loses more, a new gambling mechanic for Season 2, and even word of a next-gen port. Wardogs Season 2 launches on October 15. Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

sources.title: WARDOGS Season 2 Launches October 15 With New Weapons, Vehicles, and Rain
sources.text: WARDOGS Season 2 launches October 15, 2026, on Steam, with new weapons, vehicles, rain, experimental cash wagers, and gameplay improvements. BULKHEAD and Team 17 ‘s tactical shooter has been a major success since its September Early Access launch on Steam. Now, the first major update is coming with the October introduction of season 2. BULKHEAD has announced that WARDOGS Season 2 will introduce four new weapons and four new vehicles. It will also add new weather-based obstacles, namely rain, and an experimental wager system that lets players put in-game currency at stake; this will let players select objectives with additional conditions that can increase their payout. As for the new weapons, players will have access to the TCX-SPR Assault Rifle, M14 DMR, PP-19 Bizon SMG, and Evo-3 Ultra LMG. The added vehicles include the Wolf-110, its armed assault variant, the T-72B3 main battle tank, and the Flakpanzer Gepard anti-air vehicle. The CEO of BULKHEAD offered some comments in a press release , noting that they’ve learned a lot from watching players and will continue to use feedback in order to better change the in-game systems and create a better overall experience. “We’ve learned a huge amount from watching people play WARDOGS since launch. Season 2 gives players more weapons, vehicles and ways to play, but just as importantly, we’ve been working through the feedback and making changes to the systems that matter every match. Early Access is about continuing to build the game with our community, and this is the first major step in that process.” Are you excited for these additions coming to WARDOGS? What do you think about the game so far? Sound off about this story and all others in our official Discord server. For more WARDOGS coverage on Insider Gaming, check out BULKHEAD’s CEO comments on 2026 game pricing . Also, don’t forget to sign up for our weekly newsletter . I'm Robert DeFelice. I spent years covering pro-wrestling industry for outlets such as Fightful. After years in wrestling journalism, I’ve transitioned to video games, another passion of mine.

sources.title: Próxima semana em XBOX: novos jogos de 3 a 7 de agosto
sources.text: Boas-vindas ao Próxima Semana em XBOX! Neste post semanal, cobrimos todos os jogos que chegarão em breve ao XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX no PC e XBOX Game Pass! Confira abaixo mais detalhes sobre esses próximos jogos e clique em seus perfis para mais informações (datas de lançamento sujeitas a alteração). Vamos começar! 1499. Paris é tomada pelas chamas quando criaturas monstruosas surgem repentinamente das sombras. Trevor Belmont, o herói que derrotou Drácula, aventura-se pelas ruas em chamas ao lado de sua filha, Rose Belmont. Armados com o lendário chicote sagrado Vampire Killer, eles caçam as feras que escapam do imponente castelo. Logo, Rose se vê envolvida na sombria conspiração que se esconde por trás de tudo. Será que ela conseguirá salvar Paris da devastação? 13 de outubro – Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Deep Dish Dungeon é um jogo brasileiro de exploração de masmorras que recompensa a curiosidade e a capacidade de improvisar. Em um ambiente envolvente, explore corredores, salas e passagens por conta própria ou com até dois amigos e reúna recursos para melhorar seu acampamento. Crie ferramentas e prepare refeições nutritivas para fortalecer o grupo ao longo da jornada enquanto desvenda o enigma que se esconde nas sombras. Construa um mundo ainda mais selvagem em Planet Zoo 2 , sequência do adorado simulador de zoológicos. Dê asas à criatividade ao construir e administrar zoológicos únicos ao redor do mundo, repletos de animais impressionantes — incluindo, pela primeira vez, espécies totalmente aquáticas e voadoras. Além disso, avance na conservação animal e liberte suas espécies em vastas Reservas de Vida Selvagem personalizáveis. 13 de outubro – Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Você serviu a Napoleão. Morreu por Napoleão. E ressurgiu por Napoleão. Você é William, um soldado da Grande Armée trazido de volta de uma sepultura no campo de batalha. Mas a Europa na qual você desperta não é aquela pela qual se sacrificou. Uma praga misteriosa agora assola o continente, e você renasceu com seu poder corruptor pulsando em suas veias. Cada morte é uma oportunidade de se tornar mais forte. Domine um sistema de combate com aparos, esquivas e finalizações brutais, usando uma variedade de armas. Canalize seu poder para aprimorar ataques e desbloquear novas habilidades sobrenaturais para usar contra seus inimigos. Embarque em uma jornada inesquecível pelo mundo encantador de Teradea, onde a vida Criado no sossego de Bloomfield Village, você está prestes a ver sua vida mudar para sempre. Uma névoa misteriosa avança da Floresta dos Ecos, feras selvagens vagam sob o manto da noite e estranhos desastres ameaçam vilarejos por toda a região. Explore uma paisagem vasta e dinâmica, repleta de cavernas escondidas, ilhas remotas, cidades cheias de vida e segredos há muito esquecidos. Guiado pela Deusa da Colheita e com a ajuda dos amigos que encontrará pelo caminho, você descobrirá novas maneiras de crescer, explorar e ajudar onde for necessário. Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 é a sequência brutal e frenética do FPS retrô Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun. Dando continuidade direta aos acontecimentos do final do primeiro jogo, sua missão levará você a novos locais em uma campanha solo com caminhos ramificados, que combina de forma natural o universo sombrio de Warhammer 40,000 com a ação acelerada de um jogo de tiro em primeira pessoa. 15 de outubro – Game Pass / Entrega Inteligente / XBOX Play Anywhere Brinque, explore e registre momentos com Bluey e Bingo nesta aventura fotográfica por lugares conhecidos da série. Guarde lembranças por conta própria ou lado a lado com um segundo jogador, descubra a vida selvagem australiana e transforme momentos do jogo em diversão na vida real. Cada foto é salva no seu próprio álbum, onde você pode guardar seus melhores momentos. 15 de outubro – Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Entre no Coliseu acorrentado aos seus amigos. Chained Beasts é um roguelike cooperativo de gladiadores para um a quatro jogadores, que combina combates brutais, trabalho em equipe e momentos divertidamente atrapalhados. Será que você consegue reunir seus amigos, esmagar os inimigos, conquistar o público e recuperar sua liberdade? Enquanto se recuperam de tempos incertos, seus Peeps se veem nas costas de Kewa, uma Baleia Espacial solitária que viaja pelo universo. Construir uma cidade nas costas de uma criatura senciente traz desafios próprios, mas, à medida que você fortalece esse vínculo e percorre a galáxia, surgem grandes oportunidades de exploração e expansão sustentável. Conheça outras espécies, atenda às necessidades e aos desejos dos seus Peeps e busque a verdade sobre os ancestrais deles e sobre as Baleias Espaciais. Celebre sucessos icônicos de diferentes gerações que ganham vida com coreografias únicas. Cada década conta com identidade visual própria e uma seleção de músicas cuidadosamente escolhida, permitindo que você viaje entre eras musicais ou crie a playlist definitiva, dos clássicos nostálgicos aos hits atuais, em uma experiência fluida. Descubra tudo isso no inédito Modo Aventura, uma jornada alegre e guiada por uma história na qual você dança ao longo das décadas. Disney/Pixar Toy Story 3 Complete Edition Reabra o baú de brinquedos e prepare-se para a aventura na pele de Woody, Buzz Lightyear e Jessie em Toy Story 3 Complete Edition , uma aventura em 3D baseada no sucesso de animação de 2010, Toy Story 3 . A versão atualizada do jogo conta com gráficos aprimorados e algumas novas surpresas. Reviva momentos fiéis ao filme no Modo História ou mergulhe no mundo aberto do Velho Oeste de Woody’s Roundup no Modo Caixa de Brinquedos. Volte ao quarto de Andy ao lado de Woody, Buzz Lightyear e outros personagens clássicos em Toy Story: Retro Roundup! Esta coleção de cinco jogos inclui versões para consoles e portáteis de quatro dos primeiros títulos de Toy Story , além de Vida de Inseto . Todos os jogos foram aprimorados com novos recursos, melhorias de qualidade de vida e um baú de brinquedos

sources.title: Xbox Game Pass recebe Gears of War E-Day e mais jogos esta semana! Veja os lançamentos (10)
sources.text: Gears of War E-Day é bom? Confira review com o novo exclusivo do Xbox e PC O Xbox Game Pass é um dos serviços de assinatura de games mais democráticos da atualidade, já que é possível acessá-lo de diferentes plataformas — incluindo os próprios, consoles da Microsoft, assim como no PC, nuvem, celulares, tablets e até Smart TVs Samsung e LG com modelos de 2022 para cá. Felizmente, seu catálogo também é atualizado quase que semanalmente, trazendo inúmeras opções para os assinantes aproveitarem — e o melhor de tudo: gastando pouco em comparação às novas tendências de preços da indústria. Se veio em busca de novos jogos para jogar através do Xbox Game Pass , está no lugar certo. O serviço ganhou um reforço de peso esta semana com a chegada de quatro títulos para os assinantes aproveitarem. Confira abaixo mais informações sobre as novas aventuras! Gears of War: E-Day é uma prequel do primeiro jogo da franquia e acompanha Marcus Fenix e Dominic Santiago durante o Dia da Emergência, 14 anos antes dos acontecimentos originais. A campanha mostra o surgimento da Horda Locust e o início da batalha pela sobrevivência da humanidade. O game aposta na ação brutal característica da série, com uma história focada na origem dos personagens e do conflito contra os Locust. Gears of War: E-Day chegou no primeiro dia ao Xbox Game Pass. Echo Weaver é um metroidvania com foco em exploração, conhecimento e manipulação do tempo. No papel do último Tecelão, o jogador precisa aprender com cada ciclo temporal e utilizar as anomalias para encontrar uma forma de quebrar a repetição. A aventura combina exploração e resolução de mistérios, fazendo com que as informações obtidas durante as tentativas sejam parte essencial da progressão. O jogo também chegou no primeiro dia ao Xbox Game Pass. Forever Ago acompanha Alfred, que parte em uma viagem pelo norte após uma tragédia que muda sua vida. A aventura solo é centrada na exploração de diferentes lugares, no encontro com novos personagens e na busca por redenção. Durante a jornada, o jogador poderá registrar momentos com uma câmera, conhecer pessoas e construir novas amizades. Claro, Forever Ago também chegou ao Xbox Game Pass no primeiro dia. Por fim, Neon Abyss 2 combina plataforma e ação roguelike em um cenário cyberpunk repleto de elementos pixelados. Na pele de um personagem lançado em Nova Atenas, o jogador precisa enfrentar o Abismo e diferentes ameaças enquanto busca vingança. A experiência é construída em torno de tentativas sucessivas, com a morte fazendo parte da progressão. Cada derrota permite uma nova oportunidade de explorar o Abismo e avançar em meio aos desafios. Curtiu as indicações para jogar no Xbox Game Pass? Vale a pena dar uma conferida em Gears of War E-Day , hein? Jogue e conte pra gente o que achou nas redes sociais do Voxl e do TecMundo ! sources.text: SEGA has released a new trailer and screenshots for Crazy Taxi: World Tour showcasing the game’s Brazil map. “The striking contrast between Brazil’s dense, eclectic streetscapes and modern city life heavily inspired our team,” said Crazy Taxi: World Tour producer Kenji Kanno in a press release. “Alongside the bright, vibrant beaches and dramatic natural scenery, we hope players can immerse themselves in the beauty and excitement of Brazil.” Crazy Taxi: World Tour is due out for PlayStation 5 , Xbox Series , Switch 2 , and PC via Steam and Microsoft Store in 2027.
